create_InferenceSettings: create an InferenceSettings dataclass with tf32, activation checkpointing, merge mole, and compile flags for MLIP inference
create_MLIPInferenceCheckpoint: create an MLIPInferenceCheckpoint dataclass to hold model config, state dict, ema state dict, and tasks config
run_inference_settings_default: run the inference_settings_default function to get default InferenceSettings for general MLIP inference
run_inference_settings_turbo: run the inference_settings_turbo function to get optimized InferenceSettings for long simulations with constant composition
run_guess_inference_settings: run guess_inference_settings to resolve a string name like turbo or default into an InferenceSettings object
